sources.coordinates_source: Henriksen et al. (2025), Table 1, Locations of the hydrogen sensors in the channel
sources.article_sensor_accuracy_evidence: Henriksen et al. (2025), DOI 10.1016/j.jlp.2025.105669, reports XEN-5320 accuracy as ±1%

coordinate_frame.origin: closed rear end, floor and one side wall; physical left/right identity must be checked against article Fig. 2 before an asymmetric model is oriented
coordinate_frame.y_axis: channel length, positive from closed rear end toward open end, 0 to 5.8 m
coordinate_frame.frame_orientation_note: The article table supplies x/y/z values. Left/right handedness of x is immaterial to the symmetric unobstructed channel but must be reconciled to the figure before asymmetric geometry is used.

facility.downstream_boundary: open at y=5.8 m to expanded region

obstacle.location_anchor_convention: unresolved: source text does not state whether 2.1 m identifies the obstacle leading face, center, or another datum

article_configuration_evidence.source: Henriksen et al. (2025), Materials and methods, p. 2; Fig. 2(b), p. 3
article_configuration_evidence.first_configuration: the two top cross beams only; this is the suffix-1 configuration mapped by the O1 and O2 trial IDs
article_configuration_evidence.higher_configurations: the second configuration adds the upper and middle cross beams; the third adds all cross beams
article_configuration_evidence.interpretation_limit: The obstacle is a wooden beam assembly, not established as a solid rectangular prism. The paper figure and prose do not provide machine-readable individual beam cross-sections, exact x/y registration, or the 2.1 m location datum.

conditional_rectangular_projection_check.assumption: reported 0.8 m width lies transverse to flow and shape is a solid rectangle
conditional_rectangular_projection_check.interpretation: diagnostic only; this mismatch rejects the simple solid-rectangle interpretation, not the published beam-assembly blockage ratio

obstacle.shape_and_registration: Fig. 2(b) confirms a cross-beam assembly; the article states configuration 1 has two top cross beams, configuration 2 adds upper and middle cross beams, and configuration 3 has all cross beams. Individual beam sections and full placement are not dimensioned, so do not create a quantitative solid geometry yet
geometry_gate_reasons: The reported 36.8% (rounded to 0.37 for configuration 1) applies to a wooden assembly with two top cross beams; the individual beam cross-sections and exact projection cannot be reconstructed from the published dimensions and figure.
Obstacle x placement and the y-location anchor are not textually specified; the reported 0.8 m width-axis label is also inconsistent/ambiguous in the prose.

sensor_instrumentation.manufacturer_datasheet_inaccuracy: 1% full scale for H2 and He (preliminary specification)
sensor_instrumentation.full_scale_interpretation_for_0_to_100_v: ±1 vol%-point, if the preliminary datasheet specification applies to the installed units and configuration
sensor_instrumentation.scoring_policy: retain the paper claim and manufacturer full-scale specification as attributed uncertainty metadata; do not assert event-level accuracy without certificates

time_operator.zero_time_semantics: all four local O1/O2 repeats record both elapsed-time columns starting at 0 s, consistent with the article's release-relative origin; preserve the columns separately and do not infer drift-free synchronization
time_operator.observed_coverage_issue: in all four O1/O2 repeats, the source-flow record ends before the sensor record and the final recorded source rate is non-zero; the complete release history and full-event source/sensor operator are therefore unavailable from these CSV histories alone
time_operator.calibration_accuracy: 2025 article reports ±1% accuracy; manufacturer XEN-5320 datasheet gives preliminary 1% full-scale inaccuracy; event-specific calibration certificate not present in local dataset package
